name: visage-benchmark-videos
description: A collection of face-centric video clips hosted on Hugging Face intended to benchmark visual models on visage-related tasks such as face detection, recognition, attribute classification, and expression analysis in video. Videos provide temporal and appearance variation to assess robustness of video/face understanding models. Annotations and task definitions are task-dependent and typically used for evaluating vision and video-processing systems.
general_score_metric: accuracy (task-dependent; detection tasks may use mAP or F1)
reputation: Relatively small, community-hosted dataset on Hugging Face with limited adoption outside niche face/video research.
